jobs.description:
Our client, a leading international service provider operating in highly time-sensitive and mission-critical environments, is looking for a Customer Service Coordinator to strengthen their global operations team.

Jobomschrijving

As a Customer Service Coordinator, you become the primary point of contact for customers and international partners worldwide. You will combine customer service excellence with operational coordination, ensuring every shipment is executed flawlessly from start to finish.This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys working in an international setting, solving problems under pressure, and coordinating complex logistics operations.Customer Service Excellence

• Act as the main contact person for customers via phone and email.
• Provide proactive updates throughout the shipment lifecycle.
• Build strong relationships with customers, internal teams, and international offices.
• Resolve customer queries regarding shipments, documentation, customs requirements, transit times, and service options.
• Manage escalations and ensure rapid, customer-focused solutions.
• Translate customer expectations into clear operational instructions.
Compliance & Documentation

• Verify shipping documentation and customs requirements.
• Ensure compliance with international transportation regulations.
• Follow detailed operational procedures and quality standards.
• Support the handling of specialized shipments requiring additional care and attention.

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
• Recent graduates with a strong customer-oriented mindset are encouraged to apply.
• Strong customer focus and problem-solving abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook, Word).
• Professional level in Dutch, French and English

We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization. In this role, you will combine customer focus, analytical skills, and digital tools to ensure a smooth and proactive customer experience. Your main focus will be on managing customer orders, following up on quotations, and building long-term customer relationships.

Client Details

Our client is an internationally renowned industrial organization and market leader in innovative technical solutions for customers across Europe, the Middle East and Africa. 

Description

We are looking for a Customer Service Specialist to join an international and innovative organization. In this role, you will combine customer focus, analytical skills, and digital tools to ensure a smooth and proactive customer experience. Your main focus will be on managing customer orders, following up on quotations, and building long-term customer relationships.

 

Key Responsibilities

• Proactively manage and monitor the order portfolio.
• Anticipate potential issues and provide timely solutions to customers.
• Follow up on quotations and contribute to optimal conversion rates.
• Analyze customer data through dashboards and digital tools to determine priorities.
• Deliver personalized and high-quality customer service tailored to different customer segments.
• Collaborate closely with internal departments such as Sales, Supply Chain, and Operations to ensure an excellent customer experience.
• Actively contribute to process improvement and digitalization initiatives.
• Work with KPIs and data to continuously optimize service performance.
 

Your Profile

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent through experience.
• Initial experience in customer service, sales support, customer experience, or a similar role.
• Strong communication skills in Dutch and English. Knowledge of French is an advantage.
• Analytical mindset and comfortable working with digital tools and MS Office.
• Customer-oriented, structured, and solution-driven.
• Proactive attitude with the ability to take initiative and think alongside customers and colleagues.
• Comfortable working in an environment where change, innovation, and continuous improvement are key priorities.

Our client is a leading Belgian dealer and service partner for commercial vehicles, vans, and trucks, with multiple locations across East and West Flanders, including Brugge, Ardooie, Bavikhove, Deinze, and Aalter. The company is known for its expertise, customer-focused approach, and commitment to quality service.

Jobomschrijving

We are looking for a Diagnostic Technician to join a growing and stable automotive company specializing in vans and trucks. Brand experience is not important. What matters most is your diagnostic knowledge and ability to identify and solve technical issues efficiently.

As a Diagnostic Technician, you will be responsible for:

• Performing advanced mechanical, electrical and electronic diagnostics on vans and trucks using diagnostic equipment and vehicle software.
• Identifying faults and determining the most efficient repair strategy.
• Repairing and adjusting mechanical, electrical and electronic systems based on diagnostic findings.
• Communicating diagnostic results and completed repairs clearly to workshop management and service advisors.

Candidate Profile

• Passion for automotive technology and troubleshooting.
• Technical education in automotive engineering, mechanics, electricity, or equivalent practical experience.
• Good knowledge of vehicle diagnostics and diagnostic software.
• Experience with diagnostic equipment is required.
• Experience with a specific vehicle brand is not necessary.
• Experience with vans, commercial vehicles or trucks is an advantage.
• HEV1 certificate is a plus.
• Analytical, accurate and problem-solving mindset.
• Candidates must be able to communicate in Dutch or English.

About the Company:

Our client, headquartered in Zwijnaarde, is a leading global biotechnology company introducing groundbreaking cell therapy to Ghent. Their dedicated team plays a crucial role in improving the lives of patients battling cancer and other severe illnesses. As they continue to grow, they are looking for motivated and committed individuals to join their dynamic workforce.

Jobomschrijving

For our client, an innovative and rapidly expanding biotech company, we are currently seeking a Warehouse Associate.

Responsibilities:

As a Warehouse Associate, you will be responsible for:

• Handling biohazard materials such as blood bags and viral vectors in a temperature-controlled environment.
• Accurately processing incoming inventory by verifying purchase orders, conducting quality checks, and ensuring compliance with company policies.
• Managing equipment and materials stored at cryogenic temperatures.
• Completing Master Inspection Checks (MIC) for received goods, including transportation inspections, temperature control, integrity verification, and proper documentation.
• Filling in necessary forms and logbooks related to receiving, picking, and outbound operations in accordance with Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) and Good Documentation Practices (GDP).
• Collaborating closely with the Operations and Quality departments to facilitate production and laboratory activities at the start-up site.
• Working in a sterile environment while wearing specialized protective clothing.
• Using two SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) systems to manage inbound, picking, and outbound logistics.
• Coordinating with accounting, suppliers, and business stakeholders to enhance operational efficiency.

Candidate Profile:

• High school diploma or associate’s degree.
• Prior warehouse experience, preferably within the pharmaceutical industry.
• Strong attention to detail with the ability to complete administrative tasks such as filling out forms and maintaining logbooks.
• Excellent communication skills, with the ability to interact effectively across various levels of the organization.
• Problem-solving mindset with solid analytical and data interpretation skills.
• Strict adherence to protocols to ensure product quality and personal safety at all times.
• Ability to work independently while maintaining a high level of responsibility.
• Proficiency in English is essential.

Onze klant is één van 's werelds toonaangevende logistieke bedrijven.

Jobomschrijving

For our client Kuehne   Nagel, a leading international logistics company, we are looking for motivated Order Pickers to strengthen their team. Are you accurate and interested in working in an international environment? Then this opportunity is for you!

What will you do?

• Carefully pick and prepare customer orders.
• Use a hand scanner to process goods.
• Check, label, and safely package products.
• Correctly register products in the system.
• Contribute to the smooth and efficient operation of the logistics flow.

Who are we looking for?

• You have experience as an Order Picker.
• You are willing to work in a two-shift system. During busier periods, you may also be required to work on Saturdays.
• You can work independently but also function well as part of a team.
• You speak and understand Dutch or English well.
• You have your own transportation.

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

Are you an Inside Sales Representative with experience in the food industry and strong language skills in English plus German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese? Apply today and join an international trading environment.Your role as an Inside Sales RepresentativeFor an international company active in the food sector, we are looking for an Inside Sales Representative to support and expand commercial relationships within the meat industry. As a Sales Support Specialist and Internal Account Manager, you will be responsible for managing customer relationships and ensuring smooth follow-up of the entire sales process.Your responsibilities: 
• Manage and develop an existing customer portfolio. 
• Prepare, send and follow up on quotations. 
• Maintain regular contact with restaurants, hotels and retail customers. 
• Identify commercial opportunities and support business growth. 
• Coordinate customer requests and monitor deliveries. 
• Participate in trade fairs and industry events when required. 
• Collaborate closely with internal teams and international partners.
Your profile as an Inside Sales Representative / Internal Account Manager 
• You have experience in an inside sales, sales support, customer service or commercial administration role. 
• Experience in the food industry. 
• Experience within the meat sector is considered a significant advantage. 
• You communicate fluently in English and at least one of the following languages: German, Danish, Swedish or Portuguese. 
• You have experience with customer follow-up, quotation management and commercial administration. 
• You are comfortable working with common office software and digital systems. 
• You are willing to attend trade fairs on an occasional basis.

Our client is an International Banking Institution with an established presence in Belgium.To strengthen its Compliance team in Antwerp, the organization is currently looking for a Compliance Officer who will support the Head of Compliance and AMLCO across a broad range of regulatory and financial crime compliance responsibilities.

Jobomschrijving

• Support the Compliance Manager in the execution and monitoring of the annual compliance plan
• Contribute to the review and implementation of AML/KYC policies, procedures and transaction monitoring processes
• Ensure timely and accurate preparation of regulatory reporting and returns
• Perform ongoing transaction monitoring and escalate relevant alerts and findings to the AMLCO
• Provide compliance advice to the business regarding customer onboarding, KYC reviews, transactions and risk classifications
• Review name screening alerts, sanctions and potential matches identified during customer onboarding and periodic reviews
• Support compliance matters related to corporate banking, credit facilities, syndicated lending and correspondent banking
• Perform compliance reviews and testing in accordance with the Compliance Monitoring Plan
• Contribute to the periodic review of transaction monitoring parameters and controls
• Support the assessment and review of client, country and business-related compliance risks
• Perform data quality controls across the different compliance tools and systems
• Contribute to the Enterprise-Wide Risk Assessment and other compliance-related projects

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Law, Finance, Economics or another relevant field
• Minimum 2 years of relevant experience within Compliance in the financial sector
• Good understanding of AML/KYC, Customer Due Diligence, transaction monitoring, sanctions and embargoes
• Previous experience within banking or another regulated financial institution is a strong advantage
• A financial crime or compliance certification is considered an asset
• Strong analytical skills with attention to detail
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with different stakeholders
• Pragmatic, proactive and solution-oriented mindset
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint and Word
• Very good command of English is required, Dutch is a plus

Company

Founded in Belgium in 1935, our client has grown into an international leader in sustainable packaging solutions. Their packaging—from corrugated cardboard and solid board to tubes and protective corners—is produced with recycled paper and is 100% recyclable and biodegradable. With a long-term vision and focus on sustainability, they combine ecological and economic progress. Their products, relationships, and management style all contribute to a greener planet. Today, our client has 6,500 employees, spread across 70 locations in 21 countries. The headquarters is located in Aalst.

Jobomschrijving

For the location in Hoogstraten, our client is looking for enthusiastic operators.

Curious about how paper and cardboard are made? With our client, you will learn it all!

As an operator, you play a crucial role in the production process. These are your responsibilities:

• Setting up, operating, and monitoring machines for the production of paper and cardboard products.
• Starting and stopping machines according to prescribed procedures.
• Performing quality checks on products during the production process.
• Ensuring a smooth production process with your colleagues.
• Performing first-line maintenance on the machines.
• Reporting technical malfunctions and working with the technical department to resolve them.
Monitoring the safety instructions and ensuring they are applied in the workplace

Eager to learn and interested in growth opportunities? Then you are the operator our client is looking for!

• Working in a production environment doesn’t scare you, even if it’s noisy.
• You are a handy person with an interest in technology.
• You value safety, order, cleanliness, and quality.
• You are open to feedback and see it as an opportunity to grow.
• You demonstrate responsibility and are always ready to help others.
• You have basic PC skills.
• You will be employed in a 2-shift or 5-shift system.
• You speak good Dutch or English.

Onze klant, een biotech bedrijf, gevestigd in Zwijnaarde, is een wereldwijd biotechnologiebedrijf dat de innovatieve CAR-T celtheraptie naar Gent brengt. Het bedrijf maakt hiermee dagdagelijks het verschil in het leven van vele patiënten die lijden aan kanker en andere levensbedreigende ziektes.Ze zijn momenteel in een fase van sterke groei en zoeken gemotiveerde en toegewijde teamleden. 

Jobomschrijving

We’re looking for skilled individuals to join our mission of transforming medicine. This is more than just a job,it’s an opportunity to advance your career in a dynamic, purpose-driven environment. Whether you have a secondary education with hands-on experience or are a recent graduate with a bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related fields and especially if you’ve worked in cleanrooms, pharmaceutical manufacturing, or chemical processing,we’d love to hear from you.

We are looking for dedicated process operators to join our team at a leading biotechnology company. What can you expect in this exciting role?

Your journey begins with extensive training, where we immerse you in the world of aseptic (germ-free) and GMP (Good Manufacturing Practice) operations, including the crucial procedures you need to master.

Afterward, you will join our dynamic and driven Operations team, which works together every day to fulfill our mission. Alongside your fellow operators and team leaders, you will perform aseptic and manual production processes according to strict, proven procedures.

Daily aseptic and manual production processes

Working in a cleanroom lab environment

Executing production steps in controlled environments (grade A/B/C/D) such as spiking, media changes, cell culture, and freezing therapeutic products.

Managing equipment: inspections and maintenance

Thorough cleaning and disinfection of materials

Supporting transitions between production zones

Ensuring patients receive high-quality therapies on time

A strong sense of responsibility and passion to make a difference in the lives of patients.

Clear verbal and written communication skills with an attention to detail and the ability to follow procedures.

You thrive in fast-paced environments and are eager to learn and grow in advanced biomanufacturing.

You like structure and order, are very accurate and are willing to work in an aseptic environment with appropriate sterile clothing.

You have a relevant 'graduaat' or a bachelor’s degree. Alternatively, if you hold a secondary education diploma and have initial experience in a lab or cleanroom or hospital environment, pharmaceutical manufacturing, chemical processing, or similar regulated industries you are also eligible.

You are willing to work in a shift regime 4 days of working 4 days.

You speak very good English.

You’re excited to work with cutting-edge equipment and technologies

Our client specializes in dredging works. They provide dredging and maintenance services for waterways, ports and coastlines. Their scope of work includes sediment removal, land reclamation, and improving navigability.

Jobomschrijving

Work location: The company headquarters is located in Zwijnaarde; projects are in the Ghent area? Accommodation is not provided

Are you an experienced formwork carpenter? Or maybe you don’t have experience yet but are eager to learn? Is safety and quality your priority? If so, our client is looking for you!

Job Description:

We are looking for Formwork Carpenters to work on various construction projects. The person in this role will be responsible for assembling and dismantling formwork used to shape concrete structural elements.

Responsibilities:

• Preparation, assembly and dismantling of traditional and system formwork (e.g., Peri, Doka).• Carrying out reinforcement and formwork according to technical drawings.• Quality control of completed formwork and ensuring compliance with the project specifications.• Close cooperation with other team members and the site manager.• Ensuring workplace safety and compliance with health and safety regulations.

Requirements:

• Ability to read technical drawings.• Experience as a formwork carpenter or construction worker, welder, or fitter.• Communicative knowledge of English, Dutch, or French.• Ability to work in a team and independently perform assigned tasks.• VCA certificate is an advantage.• Category B driving licence.

Our client is the world's largest vertically integrated manufacturer of polyurethane foams. The company serves a diverse global marketplace with innovative polyurethane chemical solutions, polyester fibers, and insulation materials. With a network of more than 60 production facilities worldwide, our client has established itself as a global industry leader, recognized for its high-quality products, advanced manufacturing technologies, and commitment to employee development.

Jobomschrijving

As a Machine Operator, you will be responsible for:

• Operating and setting up production machines according to production guidelines and specifications.
• Cutting and processing foam blocks based on customer and production requirements.
• Performing quality checks on finished products, including dimensions, shape, color, and compliance with specifications.
• Using measuring tools during the production process.
• Registering production data and labeling products in the Carpy system.
• Transporting materials and products between workstations using an electric pallet truck.
• Ensuring the proper operation of machinery and carrying out basic maintenance tasks when required.

Requirements

• Previous experience in a production or manufacturing environment.
• Technical aptitude and an interest in operating machinery.
• Ability to work independently with a strong sense of responsibility and attention to quality.
• Good teamwork and communication skills.
• Working knowledge of English or Dutch sufficient for workplace communication.

Our client is one of the world's leading logistics companies.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do?

• Picking and preparing various orders using a handheld scanner or voice picking system.
• Checking, labeling, and securely packaging items.
• Registering goods correctly in the system.
• Contributing to the smooth and efficient operation of the warehouse.
• You will work in a cold environment.

Who are we looking for?

• You have experience as an order picker in a logistics environment.
• You can start quickly and are motivated to learn.
• You are flexible and willing to work in shifts (early-late, or night).
• You speak and understand English well.
• You have your own means of transportation.

About the company:

Our client, based in Zwijnaarde, is a global biotechnology company introducing innovative CAR-T cell therapy. Their team is making a daily difference in the lives of many patients suffering from cancer and other life-threatening diseases. They are currently in a strong growth phase and are looking for motivated and dedicated team members.

Jobomschrijving

Our client, a leading biotechnology company, is looking for individuals interested in joining their team as a Support Operator/Laboratory Disinfection Specialist.

Before you join their professional team, you will receive thorough training in aseptic (germ-free) work, GMP, and related procedures. As a support operator, you will be responsible for maintaining the assigned areas and production zones in the laboratory in spotless condition. With the utmost precision, you will ensure the maintenance of equipment used, and the cleanliness and disinfection of materials. You will handle cleaning agents and materials safely and correctly. The laboratory works with biological products in a strictly controlled environment where your attention to detail can impact human lives.

 

Step into the world of biotechnology and become part of a dynamic team!

Profile:

• Cleanliness and order are very important to you.

• Experience in a sterile environment is a plus.

• You are enthusiastic about teamwork and can work well both independently and in a group.

• You are highly proficient in English.

• You have at least basic knowledge of MS Office (as a large part of the job involves recording, reporting, and online training).

• Wearing a sterile suit and strictly following procedures is no problem for you.

jobs.occupation: Food Production Operator (Early, Late or Night Shift)
jobs.description:
Company located in Roeselare.

Jobomschrijving

What will you do as a Packaging Operator in the Food Industry?

• Operate, set up and monitor packaging and weighing machines
• Check the quality and correct weight of packaged products
• Identify and resolve minor malfunctions or report them in a timely manner
• Perform quality control checks, including metal detection tests
• Help maintain a clean, safe and organized working environment

• Experience as an operator or with packaging machines is an advantage, but not required
• You work accurately and have a strong eye for quality
• You speak Dutch, French, or English
• A forklift certificate is a plus
• You are willing to work in a chilled environment (5°C to 10°C)
• You are willing to work in shifts (6:00 AM to 2:00 PM, 2:00 PM to 10:00 PM, or 10:00 PM to 6:00 AM)

Company in Roeselare

Jobomschrijving

What does the role involve?

• As an operator, you are responsible for the accurate execution of production processes.
• You precisely measure materials.
• You perform calculations and ensure everything runs according to plan.
• You work in an environment where quality and precision are key.

Profile – What do we expect from you?

• Strong numerical skills and the ability to measure accurately.
• Good spatial awareness.
• Fluency in Dutch or very good proficiency in English.
• Flexibility: you work in day shifts, but are willing to switch to a two-shift system during peak workload.
• Careful and correct working method, with strong attention to detail.

Our client is a Brussels-based company operating in a technical and regulated environment, with an international scope. It stands out for its pragmatic mindset, family-oriented culture, high-quality approach and products, as well as its continuous drive to modernize internal tools and processes.As part of its digital transformation and the structuring of its IT function, our client is looking to strengthen its team by recruiting an IT Coordinator who will play a central role between users, management, and external partners.

Jobomschrijving

As an IT Coordinator, you will hold a key, cross-functional position, combining both operational and organizational responsibilities.You will cover the full IT scope: user support, infrastructure, business applications, and coordination of external service providers.You will actively contribute to the company's digitalization and ensure the continuity, reliability, and ongoing development of its IT systems.Your responsibilities :

• Provide Level 1 and Level 2 IT support to users (workstations, software, access, etc.).
• Manage and maintain IT infrastructure (networks, servers, cloud environments, security).
• Administer and optimize business applications in collaboration with an external consultant (CRM, webshop, internal tools, Office 365, etc.).
• Lead IT projects (new tools, improvements, migrations) in collaboration with various departments (e.g. CRM implementation project).
• Coordinate and manage external IT vendors and service providers.
• Identify innovation opportunities and propose continuous improvements to systems and processes.
• Support users and management through change and the adoption of new tools

• Minimum 5 years of experience in an IT coordination role or similar position.
• Versatile profile, comfortable with support, infrastructure, applications, and project management.
• Experience working with external IT service providers.
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office 365 and collaborative environments.
• Excellent organizational, autonomy, and communication skills.
• Strong sense of innovation and a genuine ability to support change.
• Languages: French and English required; Dutch is a strong asset (trilingual profile is a major plus).

Our client is a highly respected international law firm with a strong reputation for excellence and client service. With a collaborative and professional culture, the firm combines high standards with a supportive working environment where people are encouraged to take ownership and make an impact.

Jobomschrijving

• Manage the daily operations of the Brussels office
• Lead and support administrative and office services teams
• Oversee facilities, office maintenance, and workplace experience
• Coordinate suppliers, contractors, and external service providers
• Manage vendor relationships, tenders, and contract negotiations
• Monitor office budgets, expenses, and operational costs
• Organise office events, meetings, and internal initiatives
• Drive process improvements and operational efficiency projects
• Ensure compliance with health & safety and local regulations
• Coordinate onboarding and support employee experience initiatives
• Act as the main contact for landlords, building management, and external stakeholders
• Collaborate closely with leadership and international support teams
• Support business continuity, ESG, and office governance initiatives
• Coordinate local IT-related office needs and employee support

• Minimum 10 years of experience within a law firm, consultancy, or similar professional services environment
• Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken (mandatory)
• Dutch is a strong asset
• Previous people management or team leadership experience
• Excellent organisational and project management skills
• Proactive, hands-on, and solution-oriented mindset
• Able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment
• Professional, discreet, and service-driven
• Strong knowledge of Microsoft Office and digital tools
• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
